developmentBacklogAdded.name: Effective workload floor for fixed-price gigs
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Fixed-price freelance listings can look attractive while hiding an uneconomic workload, especially bulk content and recurring admin tasks.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Estimate implied hourly rate from stated volume/frequency and reject or heavily penalize listings whose conservative effective rate falls below a configurable floor before they consume review time.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Competition-to-client-activity ratio
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Proposal count alone over-penalizes active clients and under-penalizes dead listings; 50+ proposals with no interviews differs materially from 20-50 proposals with active hiring.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Score freelance urgency using proposals together with last-viewed time, interviewing, hires, invites and client spend so the radar prioritizes opportunities where the client is demonstrably active.
